blocks.text: MARIVELES, Bataan — A body of an unidentified man was found floating off the coast of Barangay Alas-asin, Mariveles town on Sunday. Residents reported the discovery to local police after spotting the body near the Maritime Academy of Asia and the Pacific (MAAP). According to the residents, the body bore tattoos with names of women and the phrase “Batang City Jail.” READ: Woman’s body found floating in Bataan waters The unidentified man was about 30 to 40 years old, according to police.
